# SQLite Amalgamation
#
# Required for the SQLite backend. Not needed for PostgreSQL-only builds.
# Run from the repository root:

mkdir -p vendor/sqlite
curl -fsSL -o sqlite3.zip "$(sh vendor/verify-sqlite.sh --url newest)"
unzip -jo sqlite3.zip "*/sqlite3.c" "*/sqlite3.h" -d vendor/sqlite
rm sqlite3.zip
sh vendor/verify-sqlite.sh

# That downloads the newest release on verify-sqlite.sh's approved list; for another
# release on it, name its version in place of newest (--url 3.53.4). verify-sqlite.sh
# checks sqlite3.c against the SHA3-256 SQLite publishes for the release, and
# sqlite3.h against a hash pinned from that same verified download, and fails unless
# both match one approved release; do not build from files that fail it. The Docker
# build and CI run the same check.
#
# Source: https://www.sqlite.org/download.html
